problems.title: Trace sorted two-sum

parts.prompt: Steps (pointer moves) before the first match?

problems.solution: 1 + 11 = 12 → move j; 1 + 8 = 9 → move i; 3 + 8 = 11 → move j; 3 + 6 = 9 → move i; 4 + 6 = 10: found (4, 6) after 4 moves.

problems.title: Exchange argument
problems.statement: Container with most water, current pair (i, j) with h[i] = 3, h[j] = 7.

options: Any pair (i, j') with j' < j is narrower and no taller than 3

hints: The shorter line caps the height.
problems.solution: Every pair still using i is narrower and capped at height 3: none can beat the current area, so i is discarded.

problems.title: Duplicates
problems.solution: Without skipping, [−2, 0, 2] can be reported twice (the second 0 or 2); with skipping, once.

problems.title: Fast and slow
problems.statement: Remove duplicates in place from a sorted array, returning the new length.

parts.prompt: Invariant for the slow pointer w?
options: a[0..w) are the distinct values seen so far, in order

hints: Copy a[i] to a[w] when it differs from a[w − 1].
problems.solution: Everything before w is finished output; result length 4.

problems.title: Sorting loses indices
problems.solution: Sort pairs: O(n log n), O(n) space. The hash map is O(n) expected; mention both.

problems.title: Dutch national flag
problems.statement: Sort an array of 0s, 1s and 2s in one pass, in place.

options: swap with a[high], high−−, don't advance mid

hints: The element swapped in from high hasn't been examined.
problems.solution: Invariant: [0, low) = 0s, [low, mid) = 1s, (high, n) = 2s, [mid, high] unknown. A swapped-in element from high is unknown, so mid stays.
